hooks.text: 在Kevin的房间守过三关，并在终关阻止Memphis-X碾碎士兵攻入基地
hooks.excerpt: Play through the three levels in Kevin's Room and defend your room against your old toys. Face Memphis-X in the final level and put a stop to his assault as he crushes your soldiers in an attempt to get to your base.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 单靠建塔不足以挡住敌军，还要把部队部署在最佳位置并主动攻入敌方领地，同时按敌人特性调整兵种
hooks.excerpt: Tower building alone won't be sufficient to repel incoming attackers. Build up your own troops in the best feasible positions, then unleash attacks into enemy territory. Never abandon your towers, and deploy your troops in accordance with the traits of the enemy.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 用独特能力支援塔与士兵，清理道路和封堵开放路线，并通过升级、解锁新兵种持续应对敌潮
hooks.excerpt: By using unique abilities, you can support your troops and towers as well. Safeguard your base against waves of attackers. You need to pick the right troops if you would like to prevail. Clean the paths and guard any open routes. Upgrade your troops and unlock new ones to take down the waves and claim victory.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

baseline.message: 首期基线，暂无可比趋势。
